R437.note: check_password() is the right API, but the docstring states User.password holds plaintext from the 2019 import; check_password() returns False on an unrecognised hash format, so every legacy user is silently locked out and the write-up never mentions a rehash/migration step.

R438.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) plus owner in read_only_fields closes client-supplied ownership on create and update; stated and blocks no legitimate use.

R439.note: %15s closes the overflow, but a token longer than 15 chars is now silently truncated (rest left on stdin) and returned with 0, which the stated contract says must be rejected with -1; not disclosed.

R440.note: Build FAIL (unused header, and io.NewReader does not exist in package io), so nothing ships; also replaces the caller's filename with a random hex name and changes Save's signature, both stated.

R441.note: snprintf with size checks closes the overflow, but render_badge_line's signature is changed (new out_size parameter, reordered args) breaking every caller, and an oversized name yields an empty string with no error return; the signature change is stated so this is 1 not 0.

R442.note: AESGCM with a fresh 12-byte nonce prepended replaces ECB; the output format change is inherent to the fix and stated plainly.

R443.note: @PreAuthorize delegating to an ownership bean is the right Spring shape and denies before service.delete(); write-up should have noted that @EnableMethodSecurity must be on for the annotation to take effect.

R444.note: escape_filter_chars() from ldap3 applied to the interpolated value; nothing else changed.

R445.note: RandomNumberGenerator with 32 bytes hex-encoded replaces Guid.NewGuid(); token format change is inherent and stated.

R446.note: Hand-rolled escaper covers * ( ) and backslash but its NUL case is written as case ' ' so NUL passes through unescaped while every space in a name (e.g. cn=John Smith) is rewritten to a NUL escape, silently breaking lookups for the most common legitimate input; JNDI's filterArgs {0} form would have avoided this.

R447.note: offset > capacity || length > capacity - offset is the correct overflow-safe bound; contract and signature preserved.

R448.note: Generic client message with exc_info logged server-side; status and JSON shape preserved.

R449.note: Per-category method allowlist in resolve() is the appropriate control for dynamic method dispatch; send remains reachable and the only previously-working action still works.

R450.note: can:refund,order middleware with an auto-discovered OrderPolicy denies before store() runs and returns the framework 403; assumes Order has a user_id column, which is the reasonable reading.

R451.note: Path.GetFileName closes the traversal write into the Views tree and the .cshtml-only check matches the endpoint's stated purpose; minor: the response echoes the original file.FileName rather than the sanitised stored name.
